intro: EU-CORE Consortium (École Centrale de Nantes) is offering a master's opportunity centred on EU-CORE – European Master on Control of Renewable Energy Systems (Erasmus Mundus). About the Scholarship

EU-CORE is the European master on control of renewable energy systems coordinated by École Centrale de Nantes with European partners. Scholarship applications open on 1 November 2026 and close on 31 January 2027 (11:59 pm GMT), with a second scholarship window noted until mid-May in the consortium's schedule.

OpportunityEU-CORE – European Master on Control of Renewable Energy Systems (Erasmus Mundus)
HostEU-CORE Consortium (École Centrale de Nantes)
LocationNantes (multi-country mobility), France
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendErasmus Mundus and Consortium scholarships for selected
Application Deadline31 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

EU-CORE is the European master on control of renewable energy systems coordinated by École Centrale de Nantes with European partners. Scholarship applications open on 1 November 2026 and close on 31 January 2027 (11:59 pm GMT), with a second scholarship window noted until mid-May in the consortium's schedule.

Programme Highlights

  • Control-focused renewable energy curriculum from École Centrale de Nantes
  • Scholarship round 1 November 2026 – 31 January 2027 (11:59 pm GMT)
  • Additional consortium scholarship consideration through mid-May per the deadlines page
  • Careers in wind, solar and hybrid energy-systems control

Who Should Apply

Electrical, control and energy engineering graduates with strong systems and programming fundamentals fit the programme.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus and Consortium scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the EU-CORE deadlines page once applications open on 1 November 2026 and submit by 31 January 2027. Key deadline information: 31 January 2027 (11:59 pm GMT, scholarship round); applications open 1 November 2026.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About EU-CORE Consortium (École Centrale De Nantes)

The EU-CORE consortium is coordinated by École Centrale de Nantes and delivers the European master on Control of Renewable Energy Systems with European partner universities.

Official website: https://master-eu-core.ec-nantes.fr

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 31 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
